outcome: remained stable for 2 years without recurrence of heart failure
cohort: The study describes a 3-month-old boy with high-output cardiac failure due to hepatic arteriovenous malformations caused by hereditary hemorrhagic telangiectasia.
finding: This case demonstrates the feasibility and effectiveness of living donor liver transplantation in pediatric HHT patients with severe cardiac complications, including right-to-left shunting.
